findings.title: Correct the competing-identifications claim for 火’s star-name use
findings.details: The draft says one account tentatively identifies 火 as 火星 while other readings identify 大火/心宿二, implying disagreement. The recorded scan review says 字源 gives the broader name 火星 without specifying 心宿二 or the planet, while the inspected CUHK 火 and 晶 entries identify the referent as 大火/心宿二 and are consistent with that wording. Preserve the distinction in specificity and the unresolved motivation for the star’s name.
findings.verification: Check the cited 字源 scan and both CUHK entries. Revise the star-name sense, its has_sense relationship, and the matching limitation to remove the asserted disagreement; obtain fresh factual and readability approvals for the changed prose.

findings.title: Keep evidence IDs out of reader-facing sense prose
findings.details: Round-2 validation rejected a reader-prose repair because it placed evidence IDs in meaning_history.senses[1].text. IDs belong in evidence_ids; the artifact does not establish that any particular proposed repair was approved.
findings.verification: Inspect the final authored article and validator behavior to confirm sense text contains no evidence IDs, citations remain in evidence_ids, and any prose repair receives the required fresh reviews.
